notes.title: Update 3
notes.content: Baring any major bug fixes we've released the final version of the game. The difficulty ramp has been eased so it's much easier to get the achievements. We also fixed a bug where the game was using way more processing power than it needed to. We also made a few cosmetic updates.

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content: We've released a second update today which fixes the impossible 200 achievement from triggering.

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content: We've updated the game to remove linear filtering from textures and also removed FXAA from the game. This is in an effort to make the game feel a little older than it is. We have left motion blur in the game because we feel this is better on people's eyes even though this graphic technique is more modern than the game is meant to look.
